text:
tess: Opening thread for tonight's deploy: flag key feature.optimize_v2_toggle. Change window 22:30-00:30 UTC. Plan: canary 0.2% (10m) -> 2% (15m) -> 10% (20m) -> 40% (20m) -> 100% manual. deploy-bot will run the shifts.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled for 2025-09-10T22:30:00Z. Will checkpoint metrics and post snapshot after each step. Will pause on holdpoints.
omar: Request: pin cohort "qa-internal" to v2 during the whole rollout for targeted checks.
tess: done. cohort=qa-internal -> pinned 100% to v2; excluded from automatic backoff.
infra-paul: Reserve note: set regional reserve=5% in eu-central to avoid autoscaler overload during 10%->40% jump. I'll push before the run.
omar: Rollback triggers we agreed: 1) user-facing 5xx > 1% sustained for 3m, 2) P95 latency +300ms vs baseline for 5m, 3) model regression flagged by eval-alerts (nonsense rate +12%). On trigger: immediate disable flag and pin route back to stable.
oncall-zoe: I'll be oncall. If deploy-bot pauses and I don't ack within 3m, policy is auto-disable. Ping @zoe.
deploy-bot: quick disable command for ops: ```curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN\" https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/feature.optimize_v2_toggle/disable```
tess: add runbook step: when shifting >40% pin session-routing to model-route=v2.0 for 1h to reduce mid-session flips: /ops/pin-sessions route=llm-route version=v2.0 duration=1h
omar: Preflight results: staging passed smoke and perf at 21:40 UTC. Ready to go.
oncall-zoe: ack. I'll monitor dash and eval slack feed. If everything is green we can consider compressing the last two steps, but only with my approval.
tess: thanks all — will post final ramp summary in this thread after cutoff.
